summary: Derive required-checks from the repository workflows

delivery.outcome: An adopter can replace the hub's inherited required-checks declaration with the one its own workflows publish, instead of discovering the falsehood as a GOV-SYNC-001 during its next upgrade and correcting it by hand.
nonGoals: Rewriting any adopter's declaration from this hub; the file is target-owned and the tool reports by default.
Guessing the context names of jobs that call a reusable workflow; those are reported for confirmation and --write refuses such a repository.
Making governance / enforce a required check in any ruleset.

architecture.decision: Derive the declaration from the job names the repository's own pull-request workflows publish, which is the only primary source. Report by default and write only when every name is derivable, because a reusable-workflow caller's context name is completed by a workflow in another repository.
interfaceChanges: scripts/generate_required_checks.py is a new tool distributed to adopters
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; no adopter declaration is touched by this change.

validation.evidence: Trigger keys are not mistaken for jobs, callers are reported rather than guessed, --write refuses a repository with a caller, and a circular exclusion stays excluded.
The hub agrees with its own declaration, including its circular exclusion.
The new package source adopts and locks cleanly.
